span.p: Ms. Pac-Man enters from the right and stops below the marquee

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Each ghost enters from the right below the marquee,
goes left, stops 4 frames at the corner,
then climbs to stack up. Its name stays on screen
until the next name.
